svg.aria-label: Romik's ambidextrous sofa in its own frame, inside the hallway that turns right, turned by π/4 about it with its outer walls touching the sofa's hull: the inner corner x(π/4) lies on the orange path that the corner traces during the turn, which bounds the niche
